bound.name: Bound
bound.note: Front pair and hind pair alternate, with suspension between.

pronk.name: Pronk
pronk.note: All four feet strike and lift together; mostly airborne.

trot.name: Trot
trot.note: Diagonal pairs strike together; two feet down at all times.

walk.name: Walk
walk.note: Four-beat gait; three feet stay down at all times.
